name: session-recap
description: Recap any AI coding session (Claude Code, Codex, dsh, OpenCode): its intent, key decisions, what changed, open threads and where to resume.

scripts.test: node scripts/build-dsh.mjs && node --test tests/cli.test.mjs tests/mcp.test.mjs tests/dsh.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.test:plugin: claude plugin validate . && claude plugin test .
scripts.lint: prettier --check . && ruff check hooks tests && ruff format --check hooks tests
